items.summary: Recommendation: authorize no additional spend, monetization expansion, or public launch this cycle; keep searchwoot.com private pending owner disposition and finance-grade gates. Supported revenue is $4.92 commission on 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items for 2026-09-21. Attribution is incomplete: 629 clicks and all 28 ordered items are under tracking_id "other", while named site IDs show zero orders and commission. Analytics is unavailable for all 60 registry sites. AI usage cost is $733.04 across 4,340 calls from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-22, including 136 errors; it is observability, not proven return. Contribution margin, cost-to-learn, CAC, payback, infrastructure spend, total operating spend, ROI, and forecasts are not calculable because site-level revenue attribution, traffic/exposure denominators, direct infrastructure/domain costs, and experiment outcome records are missing. Minimum measurement is reconciliation of affiliate events to site/content IDs, site traffic and conversion telemetry, direct cost allocation by site, and experiment exposure/incremental-outcome records. Treat clicks, ordered items, SEO activity, social coverage, and AI call volume as non-financial activity metrics; continue only already-approved measurement gates without duplicate work.
